annotations.title: Prepare a request to flatin.pt, a licensed estate agency

description: Use this when the person wants flatin.pt (licensed estate agency, AMI 28163) to contact them about buying a new-build apartment in Portugal. Do not use it to send the request (`submit_consultation`) or for emails about new projects (`subscribe_digest`). mode=link returns the form link and the consent text; mode=prepare checks the details and returns a summary, the GDPR (RGPD) consent text and a confirmation_token. Nothing is sent.

budget.description: Deprecated: use budget_max. Read as budget_max when budget_min and budget_max are both empty

budget_band.description: Deprecated: use budget_min and budget_max. An old band (0-250k, 250-400k, 400-600k, 600k+), read as its range when both are empty

budget_max.description: Optional. Upper end of the budget in whole euros; if lower than budget_min, the two are swapped

budget_min.description: Optional. Lower end of the budget in whole euros

channel.description: How the person wants to be contacted on that phone

city.description: Older name for places: one place. Merged with places, city first

client.description: Optional. Your app's host or name: recorded as the request's source

deal_type.description: Deprecated and ignored: every request is to buy

email.description: Only if the person gives no phone

intent.description: Optional. visit and reserve only with a project on sale, notify only with a project not yet on sale

language.description: The person's language: the consent text, the emails and the page links come in it. Another value is refused, except in mode=link, which falls back to English. uk is accepted as ua.

examples: Close to the metro, with a balcony

mode.description: link: only the form link and the consent text. prepare: check the details, get a summary, the consent text and a confirmation_token for submit_consultation; nothing is sent

phone.description: Phone in international format. Preferred over email

places.description: Where the person wants to buy: municipalities in Portugal (Lisboa or Lisbon) or districts, most important first. At least one place, unless project is given (the project's municipality comes first then)

preferred_time.description: Optional, with intent=visit: when suits the person

project.description: Optional. Slug of the development the request is about: the slug field of search_newbuilds

property_type.description: Deprecated and ignored: every request is for a new-build apartment

typology.description: Optional. Bedroom counts wanted (T2 = two bedrooms)

name: request_consultation

anyOf.description: mode=link: the form link and the consent text; nothing is sent.
mode=prepare: summary, consent text and token; nothing is sent.

outputSchema.description: Success, or a refusal with an error code. Units: *_cents euro cents, *_eur euros, *_eur_m2 euros per m², *_pct and percent in percent.

title: Prepare a request to flatin.pt, a licensed estate agency
